$description: m3l-design semantic tokens, light theme. Every token aliases a primitive directly (no semantic-to-semantic chains).

default.$description: Page/app background. Every text color is checked against it in both themes.

subtle.$description: Alternating bands, sidebars, docs nav. Text-safe for all text tokens.

sunken.$description: Inset wells, table header rows, badge backgrounds.

raised.$description: Cards, popovers, menus. Pairs with a shadow in light mode, with a lighter surface in dark mode.

hover.$description: Hover fill for rows, nav items, ghost buttons. Worst-case surface for text contrast checks.

code.$description: Code block and inline code background.

selected.$description: Selected row / current nav item fill (accent tint).

primary.$description: Body copy and headings. >=15:1 on every surface, both themes.

secondary.$description: Supporting copy, metadata, table secondary cells. >=7:1 on every surface.

tertiary.$description: Lowest-emphasis readable text: placeholders, timestamps, captions. Still >=4.5:1 on every surface; do not go lighter.

disabled.$description: Disabled control labels only. Exempt from WCAG 1.4.3 (inactive UI), so NOT contrast-safe: never use for readable content.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent fills (primary button). Light: near-white; dark: near-black.

subtle.$description: Decorative dividers and card outlines. Not a control boundary: under 3:1 on purpose.

default.$description: Stronger decorative rules (table grid, section breaks). Not a control boundary.

control.$description: Input, checkbox, secondary-button boundaries. >=3:1 vs every surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

default.$description: Primary action fill, active indicators, the one brand color.

hover.$description: Hover state of accent fills and accent text.

tint.$description: Low-emphasis accent background (selected chips, highlighted callout). Accent text stays >=4.5:1 on it.

text.$description: Links and accent-coloured text. Links must also be underlined (never colour alone, WCAG 1.4.1).

ring.$description: Keyboard focus outline, drawn 2px wide at a 2px offset so it sits on the surface (>=3:1 vs every surface).

text.$description: Approved 2026-09-26. Status info text colour (titles, labels). >=4.5:1 on default/subtle/raised surfaces and on its own status surface. Always pair with an icon and a text label: never colour alone.

border.$description: Approved 2026-09-26. Status info border, indicator edge and icon. >=3:1 vs surfaces (WCAG 1.4.11). Lightness is staggered across statuses (danger is the darkest indicator in both themes, success/warning the lightest) so they stay distinguishable with red-green colour blindness.

text.$description: Approved 2026-09-26. Status success text colour (titles, labels). >=4.5:1 on default/subtle/raised surfaces and on its own status surface. Always pair with an icon and a text label: never colour alone.

border.$description: Approved 2026-09-26. Status success border, indicator edge and icon. >=3:1 vs surfaces (WCAG 1.4.11). text.$description: Approved 2026-09-26. Status danger text colour (titles, labels). >=4.5:1 on default/subtle/raised surfaces and on its own status surface. Always pair with an icon and a text label: never colour alone.

Lightness is staggered across statuses (danger is the darkest indicator in both themes, success/warning the lightest) so they stay distinguishable with red-green colour blindness.

1.$description: Resting cards, buttons with a lift.

4.$description: Dialogs. In dark mode elevation also steps the surface (surface-raised); shadows alone barely read.
